https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/10138

`pnpm-workspace.yaml` (not sure why `docs` was in there...) and that we
are using `pnpm` over `npm` consistently (which is why this PR deletes
`codex-cli/package-lock.json`).

are using `pnpm` over `npm` consistently (which is why this PR deletes
`codex-cli/package-lock.json`).
